review:
Blade Lineage Yi Sang is very consistent at maintaining both his poise count and potency while also having a high clashing power for every few poise count at Uptie 4. Although he will need time to ramp up, he becomes a clashing monster once Poise is there.
 Him not having much potency gain actually helps him because you would want to keep that count high to maintain his coin power.
 No notable E.G.O. Synergies
